versions.content: If the current global status is WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_OK or WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_FAILED then for each Supervised Entity that is activated in the new mode (passed to function WdgM_SetMode as parameter), the function WdgM_SetMode shall retain the current state o f the Supervised Entity . Switching to the mode where a Supervised Entity is deactivated clears also errors that had resulted with the WDGM_GLOBAL_STATUS_FAILED status.
